Effect: [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less. For every Digimon your opponent has in play, add 2000 to the maximum this DP-based deletion effect can delete.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, if you have a Tamer in play, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the highest DP.
